mapper.select: select id,name,provider_code,model_id,revision,endpoint,parameters from p_official_service where capability='TTS' and status='ACTIVE' order by id desc
select id,name,provider_code,model_id,revision,endpoint,parameters from p_official_service where id=#{id} and capability='TTS' and status='ACTIVE' for update
mapper.sql: voice.visibility='OFFICIAL' and voice.status='PUBLISHED' and exists(select 1 from p_voice_version v join p_official_service s on s.id=v.official_service_id where v.id=voice.current_version_id and v.service_type='OFFICIAL' and s.status='ACTIVE' and s.capability='TTS' ) and voice.status=#{status}
mapper.select: select count(*) from p_voice voice where

select voice.id,voice.name,voice.description,voice.status,voice.current_version_id,voice.revision,voice.created_at,v.version_no,v.voice_code,v.language_code,v.model_id from p_voice voice left join p_voice_version v on v.id=voice.current_version_id where order by voice.created_at desc,voice.id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}

select id,name,description,status,current_version_id,revision,updated_at from p_voice where id=#{id} and visibility='OFFICIAL' and account_id=#{account} and status not in ('DELETING','DELETED') for update
select from p_voice_version where voice_id=#{voice} order by version_no desc
select from p_voice_version where id=#{id} and voice_id=#{voice} and service_type='OFFICIAL'
select id from p_voice_version where voice_id=#{voice} order by version_no desc limit 1
select coalesce(max(version_no),0)+1 from p_voice_version where voice_id=#{voice} for update
mapper.insert: insert into p_voice_version(id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,voice_id,version_no,service_type,official_service_id,voice_code,language_code,model_id,parameters,official_config_snapshot,created_by) values(#{id},utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),#{account},#{voice},#{number},'OFFICIAL',#{service},#{alias},#{language},#{model},cast(#{parameters} as json),cast(#{snapshot} as json),#{account})
mapper.update: update p_voice set status='PUBLISHED',current_version_id=#{version},updated_at=utc_timestamp(3),revision=revision+1 where id=#{voice} and revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: select request_hash,resource_id from p_api_idempotency where account_id=#{account} and scope=#{scope} and request_id=#{key} for update
mapper.update: update p_api_idempotency set status=#{status},updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{account} and scope=#{scope} and request_id=#{key} and status!='SUCCEEDED'
mapper.select: select count(*) from p_api_idempotency where account_id=#{account} and scope=#{scope} and resource_id=#{version} and status='SUCCEEDED'
